notes: AUC-PR 0.158, recall 0.64 at 1% FPR, catches about A$76k of fraud a month; a score from tree path lengths gives no per-feature reason for a block; AUC-PR falls to 0.040 on later payments (noise has little effect, 0.149); recall on small payments only 0.24; trains in 0.5 s and is stable across seeds

AUC-PR 0.690, recall 0.83 at 1% FPR, catches about A$128k a month and saves the most (A$141k); per-feature reconstruction error shows which features drove a block, top 5 (V17, V14, V12, V10, V16) give 60%; unaffected by noise (0.693) but drops to 0.262 on later payments; recall 0.76 on small payments with false positives under 0.2%; 37 s to train, stable across seeds (SD 0.004)

AUC-PR 0.624, recall 0.84 at 1% FPR, catches about A$123k a month; gradient saliency is spread out (top 5 give 37%), hard to turn into a reason for the customer; best on later payments (0.523) but collapses with small noise (0.002 at SD 0.1, ranking inverted); recall 0.72 on small payments with false positives under 0.2%; 126 s to train and unstable across seeds (SD 0.049, one seed 0.568)
